notes: Evidence-based passes: 'cheaper options now that DIY cameras exist' ties the cause to the facts (rule 2). The stage 2 reason restates the new fact with no conclusion (rule 5).

responses.value: Customers are probably leaving for cheaper options now that DIY cameras exist. I'd ask cancelling customers where they went.
60% say they moved to a $10 DIY system, against our $45.
